# Guest House Akutsa

> Family guest house, mountain cottage and camper in Akutsa village, Keda Municipality, Adjara, Georgia — 40 km (about one hour) from Batumi. Home-cooked Georgian food, tours, transfers and masterclasses. The site is available in Georgian (ka), English (en) and Russian (ru).

Contact: WhatsApp / Telegram +995 577 22 52 89

## Stay

- [Guest house](https://www.akutsaresosort.ge/en/guesthouse): 4 themed rooms, shared kitchen and 60 m² terrace, from 90 GEL a night
- [Panorama Akutsa cottage](https://www.akutsaresosort.ge/en/cottage): private cottage for up to 2 guests, 150 GEL a night
- [Camper](https://www.akutsaresosort.ge/en/camper): 100 GEL a night
- [Book online](https://www.akutsaresosort.ge/en/book)
- [House rules](https://www.akutsaresosort.ge/en/house-rules): check-in from 14:00, check-out by 12:00, no smoking indoors, quiet hours 22:00–08:00, pets by agreement

## Services

- [Services](https://www.akutsaresosort.ge/en/services): breakfast, transfers, picnic area for up to 60 people, masterclasses, local products
- [Yoga retreat venue](https://www.akutsaresosort.ge/en/yoga-retreat): a venue for yoga teachers to host retreats near Batumi, with terrace, accommodation, meals and group transfers
- [Menu](https://www.akutsaresosort.ge/en/menu)
- [Tours](https://www.akutsaresosort.ge/en/tours)
